Overview

An open-source C++ library, command-line toolkit, and Python interface for reproducible mass spectrometry data processing in metabolomics and proteomics.

Detailed capability map

What can this tool do?

Peak or feature detectionRetention-time alignmentGap fillingProvenance tracking

Common uses

  • Assemble reproducible command-line or Python workflows for LC-MS data processing.
  • Convert, inspect, detect, align, quantify, and annotate mass spectrometry features.

Scientific fit

Primary function

Workflow management and reproducibility

Other functions

Data conversion and import, Preprocessing and feature extraction, Quantification and targeted analysis, Metabolite annotation and identification, Visualization and reporting

Analysis types

Targeted metabolomics, Untargeted metabolomics, Metabolite profiling

Data compatibility

Inputs

Raw instrument data, Mass spectra, Feature or peak table, Sample metadata

Outputs

Feature or peak table, Mass spectra, Compound list or annotations, Human-readable report

Input formats

mzML, mzXML, MGF, CSV or TSV, mzData

Output formats

mzML, mzTab-M, CSV or TSV, featureXML, consensusXML
